verdict.rationale: Mollie documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.mollie.com/mcp that proxies its public API. It exposes scoped tools for 13 APIs, and the docs give client configs for Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code, so an agent can be connected directly. A probe confirms the docs page exists. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the server works as documented, and coverage of the remaining APIs such as Refunds and Chargebacks (clients also connect via the mcp-remote bridge).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Mollie MCP server enables merchants to use various AI tools like Claude Desktop and Cursor AI to utilize natural language for creating different resources in their Mollie account.
You can find Mollie MCP server at `https://mcp.mollie.com/mcp`, which acts as a proxy for the public API.
